props.title: Why Does Sunburned Skin Need Gentle Treatment?
props.text: After prolonged sun exposure, the skin can become warm, dehydrated, tight, and more sensitive than usual. A Sunburn Treatment uses cooling ingredients such as aloe vera together with gentle application techniques to calm overheated skin without adding unnecessary pressure. The goal is to restore comfort, replenish moisture, and support the skin's natural recovery process after time in Bali's tropical sun.

items.question: Can I get a massage if I have sunburn?
items.answer: Yes, provided the skin is not blistered or severely damaged. The Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak avoids deep pressure and uses cooling aloe vera with gentle techniques specifically intended for sensitive skin. The session lasts 1 hour and costs IDR 250.000 per person. If your skin is blistered or severely burned, see a doctor instead.

items.question: Why is aloe vera commonly used after sun exposure?
items.answer: Aloe vera is widely used in after-sun care because of its cooling properties and its ability to help maintain skin hydration while soothing temporary discomfort. The Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak applies cooling aloe vera with light, non-irritating movements for 1 hour, at IDR 250.000 per person, at our spa or your villa.

items.question: Is this treatment suitable immediately after the beach?
items.answer: Yes. Many guests book the Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon after spending long hours outdoors, at the beach or by the pool, to help cool and rehydrate their skin. The session lasts 1 hour and costs IDR 250.000 per person, at our Seminyak spa or your villa. It is not suitable for blistered or severely burned skin.

items.question: Do sunburns give me a tan?
items.answer: Sometimes, but it is not a safe way to tan. A sunburn can be followed by tanning as the skin produces more melanin, but a sunburn is a sign of skin damage. For mild sunburn, the Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon cools and rehydrates the skin with aloe vera, IDR 250.000 per person for 1 hour.

items.question: Does the treatment focus on the whole body?
items.answer: It can. During the Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon, our therapist may treat the entire body or concentrate only on the sun-exposed areas that need the most attention, such as the shoulders, upper back, arms, legs or chest. The affected areas are assessed first, and the session lasts 1 hour, at IDR 250.000 per person.

items.question: How long do sunburns last?
items.answer: Mild sunburns usually improve within a few days and heal within about a week. More severe sunburns can take longer to heal, especially if the skin blisters or peels. For mild sunburn, Spa Bali Moon's Sunburn Treatment in Seminyak (1 hour, IDR 250.000) cools and rehydrates the skin; for blistered or severely burned skin, see a doctor.

items.question: Can I return to the sun after my appointment?
items.answer: It's recommended to give your skin time to recover first. After your Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon, allow time before further sun exposure, and apply appropriate sun protection when you go outdoors again. The treatment lasts 1 hour and costs IDR 250.000 per person, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.

items.question: How much does a sunburn treatment cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: The Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak costs IDR 250.000 per person for 1 hour. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist. You can pay by Visa, Mastercard or cash, and book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, between 9am and 11pm daily.

items.question: Can I get the sunburn treatment if my skin is blistered?
items.answer: No. The Sunburn Treatment at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak is for mild sunburn, when skin feels hot, dry or tight after beach or pool days. If your skin is blistered or severely burned, the treatment is not suitable and you should see a doctor first. Your therapist checks the skin condition before the treatment starts.
